emulator: ClaudionBackgroundQA20261102 (disposable, /private/tmp AVD), serial emulator-5570, Android 15 / API 35, google_apis_playstore arm64
application: com.bazim.claudioncheckin debug (JS from local Metro), versionCode 24
backend: test-utils/locationAccessQa/mock_backend.py on 127.0.0.1:8765 (emulator 10.0.2.2), synthetic employee QA-ANDROID-001; no production tenant or attendance data
authentication: Synthetic QR fixture, then the real Login UI and generate_token_secure; no session or server record seeded
method: Location access granted (fine, coarse, background) and POST_NOTIFICATIONS before sign-in; geofence registered by the app (mode 2, tenant geo_tagging true).

Crossings: adb emu geo fix between office (25.2854, 51.5310, r=100 m) and outside (25.29, 51.54). Google Maps held a foreground location request so the emulator's fused provider consumed injected fixes; the attendance app stayed in the background.

Before every crossing the app process was killed with adb shell am kill (not force-stop). Offline = svc wifi disable + svc data disable (Active default network: none). Server outage = mock control network:503.

Evidence read after the fact: bounded native diagnostics journal and WorkManager DB via run-as, app SQLite via run-as copy, backend state, logcat events buffer. No inspector attached to the headless runtime.

steps: Backend 503 at 13:01:55; EXIT 13:01:57 queued as row 2; retry timer armed 30 s, 60 s, 120 s (fired ~90 s late), 300 s

afterDesign.duplicateProtection: Package replacement repaired the registration and produced an initial ENTER while already checked in (event 4): handled with no punch. Backend dedupe never needed; all names unique.
afterDesign.concurrency: worker.start/worker.complete strictly alternate; follow-ups start only after the previous pass completes.
